items.name: Composite Longbow +1
items.description:
You need at least two hands to use a bow, regardless of its size. You can use a composite longbow while mounted.

All composite bows are made with a particular Strength rating (that is, each requires a minimum Strength modifier to use with proficiency). If your Strength bonus is less than the strength rating of the composite bow, you can’t effectively use it, so you take a –2 penalty on attacks with it.
